correctness.rationale: The full-interval weighted-median projection is explicitly used. Exact leaf-gap and normalized outer recursions were rederived; the inner branch is invariant, finite switching follows for lambda<=1, and induction gives an open permanently alternating region for lambda>1. Absolute convergence of the hub-midpoint deviations yields global consensus. An exact-rational witness and closed-form consensus formula were independently recomputed within this review.
